comment: Shared RFC 5545 SUMMARY vectors (#112). The Rust exporter in app/src-tauri/src/core.rs is normative; app/src/lib/fake.ts mirrors it. Both test suites (core.rs tests, app/src/lib/fake.test.ts) check against these cases so the two can never drift apart. `summary` is the raw action summary; `escaped` is its RFC 5545 TEXT encoding before folding.

cases.name: CRLF cannot inject a calendar property
a lone CR becomes a newline, not a control character
long unicode text folds without splitting a code point
